1 Introduciion

1.1 Read data

# filenames
datapath <- "e:/Projects/GPWG/work/feedback/data/"
char_file <- paste(datapath, "GCDv3i/", "v3i_nsa_globe_binboot_nt2kb_pbw10_bw20_200.csv", sep="")
char_label <- "Normans (20-yr bins)"
tmp_file <- paste(datapath, "Mann_etal_tmp/", "aaves_tmp_land_binboot_v1_bw20_200.csv", sep="")
tmp_label <- "Mann et al. temp. (land) (20-yr bins)"
# read data
char_data <- read.csv(char_file); names(char_data)
tmp_data <- read.csv(tmp_file); names(tmp_data)
# merge data
data_all <- as.data.frame(matrix(NA, nrow=114, ncol=4))
names(data_all) <- c("age", "YearCE", "char", "tmp")
data_all[1:3] <- char_data[1:3]
data_all$tmp[1:dim(tmp_data)[1]] <- tmp_data[1:dim(tmp_data)[1], 3]
data_all <- data_all[1:41, ]
print(data_all)

1.2 Scatter plots

attach(data_all)
plot(tmp, char, pch=16, cex=0.5, xlim=c(-.6, .7), ylim=c(-.3,.5), xlab=tmp_label, ylab=char_label)
text(tmp, char, lab=YearCE, cex=0.7, pos=1)

detach(data_all)

2 Regression

char_lm01 <- lm(char ~ tmp, data=data_preind)
summary(char_lm01)
## 
## Call:
## lm(formula = char ~ tmp, data = data_preind)
## 
## Residuals:
##       Min        1Q    Median        3Q       Max 
## -0.085433 -0.020956  0.003749  0.018052  0.077410 
## 
## Coefficients:
##             Estimate Std. Error t value Pr(>|t|)  
## (Intercept) -0.04334    0.02100  -2.063   0.0505 .
## tmp          0.05780    0.05984   0.966   0.3441  
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
## 
## Residual standard error: 0.03516 on 23 degrees of freedom
## Multiple R-squared:  0.03899,    Adjusted R-squared:  -0.002795 
## F-statistic: 0.9331 on 1 and 23 DF,  p-value: 0.3441
oldpar <- par(mfcol=c(2,2))
plot(char_lm01, which=c(1,2,4))
acf(char_lm01$residuals, main="ACF of residuals", font.main=1)

par <- oldpar
attach(data_preind)
plot(tmp, char, pch=16, cex=0.5, xlim=c(-.5, .2), ylim=c(-.2, .1), xlab=tmp_label, ylab=char_label)
text(tmp, char, lab=YearCE, cex=0.7, pos=1)
abline(char_lm01, col="red")

detach(data_preind)
